name: Invoke Infernal Bargain

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You are not doomed

---
Effect You call upon your infernal pact to surge with devilish power. You gain a +2 status bonus to the next attack roll, skill check, or saving throw you attempt before the end of your next turn. You then become Doomed 1.
